entries.title: Candidate integrity, truth, and feature freeze
entries.acceptance: Canonical Debug source builds; qualification evidence is current, commit-bound, and rejects stale binaries; scope and P0 policy gates pass.

entries.title: Project transactions, references, history, and migrations
entries.acceptance: Cross-document operations are atomic, reference-aware, undoable, recoverable, and migration fixtures round-trip without silent loss.

entries.title: URPG design system and editor shell
entries.acceptance: Primary routes use shared tokens/widgets, scale responsively, expose accessible focus semantics, and support the golden creator loop.

entries.title: Governed asset lifecycle
entries.acceptance: Asset jobs are bounded and cancellable; safe relink/replace/delete, revisions, rights metadata, and package closure are proven.

entries.title: Map productivity and world flow
entries.acceptance: The canonical Map workspace supports productive authoring and a two-map transfer loop entirely through the UI with undo/save/runtime proof.

entries.title: Event authoring depth
entries.acceptance: Creators can author, validate, debug, and round-trip the vertical-slice event logic without raw project-file edits.

entries.title: Database, gameplay, and balance productivity
entries.acceptance: Golden-slice records support responsive bulk editing, stable references, validation preview, undo, and runtime integration.

entries.title: Menu and player-UI authoring
entries.acceptance: Editable original templates, responsive canvas layout, typed binding, state transitions, and focus-flow validation match runtime output.

entries.title: Playtest, debugging, recovery, and support
entries.acceptance: The exact creator journey, bounded reload/debugging, recovery drills, replay, performance capture, and redacted support bundle pass.

entries.title: Presentation, accessibility, localization, and input
entries.acceptance: Runtime presentation is cohesive and original; controller, keyboard, scaling, reduced-motion, muted, contrast, and locale matrices pass.

entries.title: Performance, reliability, packaging, and platform seam
entries.acceptance: Budgets, stress/fault/security checks, deterministic packages, clean-machine lifecycle, and capability-based platform services pass.

entries.title: Creator-authored vertical slice
entries.acceptance: A representative creator completes the exact vertical slice, package, install, save, relaunch, and evidence bundle from the product UI.

entries.title: External usability, beta, and release candidate
entries.acceptance: External users meet the accepted journey threshold, P0/P1 findings are dispositioned, and the final evidence index supports an explicit release decision.

entries.title: NVIDIA ARDy conditional offline research pilot
entries.acceptance: Admission gates pass and an isolated, governed pilot demonstrates measured value without runtime or package dependencies.
